SELECT COUNT(1) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE AND o.payment_status = 'PAID'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE AND o.payment_status = 'PAID'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT o.user_id FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY o.user_id HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) t

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(o.placed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') DATE_FORMAT(o.placed_at, '%x-W%v') DATE_FORMAT(o.placed_at, '%Y-%m') CONCAT(YEAR(o.placed_at), '-Q', QUARTER(o.placed_at)) DATE_FORMAT(o.placed_at, '%Y')
AS period, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_quantity), 0) AS salesQuantity FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT p.product_name AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COALESCE(u.gender, 'UNKNOWN') AS label, COUNT(1) AS value FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY u.gender
SELECT COALESCE(u.user_tag, 'UNKNOWN') AS label, COUNT(1) AS value FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY u.user_tag

SELECT
COALESCE(u.city, 'UNKNOWN') COALESCE(u.district, 'UNKNOWN') COALESCE(u.province, 'UNKNOWN')
AS regionName, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY regionName ORDER BY salesAmount DESC

SELECT
COALESCE(u.city, 'UNKNOWN') COALESCE(u.district, 'UNKNOWN') COALESCE(u.province, 'UNKNOWN')
AS regionName, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE AND o.payment_status = 'PAID'
AND u.province = #{parentRegion} AND u.city = #{parentRegion}
GROUP BY regionName ORDER BY salesAmount DESC
